newsitem.title: USA: WSMP to buy restaurants from franchisee.
newsitem.headline: WSMP to buy restaurants from franchisee.

text.p: WSMP Inc said on Tuesday that it has agreed to buy 14 restaurants from its largest franchisee and former president Cecil Hash.
The agreement would increase the number of company-operated restaurants by nearly 75 percent, WSMP said.
WSMP agreed to buy 13 Western Steer restaurants and one Prime Sirloin restaurant from Hash, the company said.
The acquisition is being largely paid for by the private placement of new shares of WSMP common stock.
The acquisition price was not immediately available.
A WSMP spokesman said Hash received about $3.8 million for the restaurants, payable primarily in stock. Hash now owns slightly less than 10 percent of WSMP's outstanding shares, the spokesman said.
WSMP said the acquisition will help the company's cash flow, net income and fully diluted earnings per share.
